items.claim: `fit()` and the refit after a layout run fold container poses into already-world poses a second time
Double-clicking an end label edits or creates the middle label
items.note: Also 02ca3f3b9d: `onEditLabel` now gets `(edge, end?)` and a custom `commit` gets the pressed `labelId`, with a new `labelEndOf` export. Changeset level `minor`, since this adds API.
This also covers reconnect, waypoints and route commands, which all call it.

items.claim: Connect with custom `routers` shows the custom route in the preview but commits an edge drawn with `EDGE_DERIVE_PATH`
items.note: The new `edgeDerivePath` option carries the host's registered derive path. Development warns when `routers` or `frame` is set without `edgeDerivePath` or `commit`. The `frame` half was found in the sweep. Behavior call recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: DiagramView's connect preview uses a different router from the one the reported edge is drawn with
items.note: If `portOptions.router` is set, the preview uses it and `onConnect`'s edge names it. If unset, the preview uses `'bezier'` (what `diagramScene` uses) and the edge names no router. Behavior call recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: relayoutBodies measures a face the build didn't use, so stencil-inserted rows move on a theme change
items.note: `stencilInsertOps` now measures in the face it stores, through a new internal `filledMeasure` helper in `rowMeasure.ts`.

items.claim: useDiagramTools gives tools to stencils (containers, and every non-flowchart group) that the `useStencilInsert` its doc pairs it with can't build
items.note: Development now warns once per unknown stencil id, and the doc names `containers: CONTAINER_STENCILS`. Behavior call recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.
